_note: Night bandits (Tim OK'd 2026-10-17). They walk in from the map's edge spots (district 'edges') at night, roam between its pois, and walk back out at dawn. Neutral until hit: then they and every bandit within joinRadius fight that clan until angrySeconds pass without being hit or nobody of it is within giveUpDistance. They die at 0 HP (no downing) and pay ryo (+/- ryoSpread) to the killer's clan. No heat. Stats live in units.json types. Seconds and world units; tune in playtests.
